title: Oprah's Book Club pick Maria Semple reads "Go Gentle" excerpt
summary: Oprah Winfrey selected "Go Gentle" by New York Times best-selling author Maria Semple, known for "Where'd You Go, Bernadette," as her latest book club pick. Watch the author, Maria Semple, read an excerpt from her novel that Oprah calls "one wild ride of a story that carries equal parts wit and wisdom.
